title: Documents
inheritedHelp: Inherited: documents of what this entry is based on. They are read-only here – open them to change them.
generatedHelp: Written by an import of a gateway configuration: its generated section is rewritten by the next import, your own text below it stays.
hidden_one: {{count}} more document you may not read
hidden_other: {{count}} more documents you may not read
noType: There is no document type for living documents. An administrator can add one under Documents → Document types.
linkHelp: The link belongs to the document: you need the right to change it. Its editors can remove the link there.
removeLinked_one: {{count}} document links to {{name}}. Remove the data collection and that link?
removeLinked_other: {{count}} documents link to {{name}}. Remove the data collection and those links?

flow.help: Documentation only: Steward runs no step and no code. Every item goes to every sink; a sink's mapping names the item there.
flow.stepsHelp: Rename, scale, aggregate, filter, enrich, compute, format
flow.noSinks: No sink is documented: where does the data go?
flow.hiddenTarget: a target you may not see

sink.name: Name
sink.refItemHelp: The id of the Steward item
sink.refDatasetHelp: The key of the Steward dataset
sink.refTextHelp: A broker, a database, a service – as text
sink.objectHelp: A topic, a table, an asset and aspect, a bucket path
sink.scheduleHelp: When the data is written, e.g. every 10 s in batches of 100
sink.stepsHelp: In the order they happen. Expressions and code are kept as text and never run.
sink.expressionHelp: A new name, a factor, a condition, a formula – text only
sink.mappingHelp: The name each item has in the sink and a transformation for that item only (optional).

sources.title: Kept versions
sources.help: Each import keeps the collector's files as Steward stores them: secret values (passwords, tokens, keys, credentials) are removed first. Only the paths where values were removed are listed – never the values.
sources.empty: No file is kept yet: import the collector's configuration to keep one.
sources.noChanges: The files have the same content.
sources.truncated: There are more changes than shown here: download both versions to compare them in full.

current.dueHelp: Not confirmed for longer than {{months}} months – a hint, nothing is wrong.

health.interval_one: The documentation of this site should be confirmed as still current every month.
health.interval_other: The documentation of this site should be confirmed as still current every {{count}} months.
health.noInterval: No review interval for this site – documents and assets are never “due”. Who manages the site sets one on its overview.
health.typeIntervals: Document types with their own interval (months): {{list}}
health.confirmed_one: {{confirmed}} of {{count}} asset has its documentation confirmed as still current.
health.confirmed_other: {{confirmed}} of {{count}} assets have their documentation confirmed as still current.
health.help: What is missing from the documentation, and what has not been looked at for a while. Each entry leads to where to fix it.
health.clean: Nothing is missing, and nothing is due for a look.

gaps.kpiNotCollected: KPIs the machines could have, not collected

gapsHelp.assetNoProfile: Without a profile Steward knows no data points, interfaces or KPIs of the asset.
gapsHelp.deviceNoVlan: The network identity is incomplete: which VLAN is the device in?
gapsHelp.pathNoSink: Where does the data go? A data path needs at least one destination.
gapsHelp.collectionNoSink: Where does the collected data go? Add a sink.
gapsHelp.collectionNoItems: The collection reads nothing yet – import the collector’s configuration or add items.
gapsHelp.kpiNotCollected: The device delivers every input, but no data collection maps them yet.

hints.assetNotConfirmed: Asset documentation not confirmed for a long time
hints.documentNotConfirmed: Documents not confirmed for a long time

hintsHelp.assetNotConfirmed: Older than the site’s review interval. A gentle hint: open the asset and confirm that its documentation is still current.
hintsHelp.documentNotConfirmed: Older than the review interval of their type or the site. Confirm them as still current where they are listed.

review.label: Documentation review interval
review.help: How often the documentation of this site should be confirmed as still current. A hint when due, never an alert. Empty: none.

settings.title: Review intervals of documents
settings.help: How often documents of a type should be confirmed as still current on plant pages – instead of the site’s interval. Empty: the site’s interval.

ih.title: Insights Hub mapping
ih.help: Each item goes to an asset, aspect and variable of its own – one collection may feed several assets and aspects. Steward checks that they exist in the tenant, not the asset hierarchy: it differs from the plant’s on purpose.
ih.lastRun: Checked on {{date}} by {{by}} with the identity {{identity}} ({{assets}} assets read)
ih.neverChecked: Not checked against the tenant yet.
ih.capped: More assets than one check reads: the rest is not checked. Check again in smaller collections or ask an administrator.

error.forbidden: The identity may not read Asset Management
error.failed: The check could not read Insights Hub

ih.itemsLabel: Items and where they go in Insights Hub
ih.placeholderMissing: {{placeholder}}: the asset has no such external reference
ih.monitorsHelp: Existing monitors come first: a check that reads the same asset and aspect with the variable watches it already. Freshness alone says little about a machine that may be off on purpose – monitors with states keep planned off times quiet.
ih.createHelp: One freshness check per asset and aspect for the variables nobody watches, with the delay measured on the asset’s other checks. No monitor with states is linked to the asset: add states before you enable it.
ih.createHelpLeader: One freshness check per asset and aspect for the variables nobody watches, with the delay measured on the asset’s other checks, following the states of {{name}} – Off there keeps these checks quiet. It is created disabled: review it and enable it on its page.
ih.editHelp: The variable is the item’s name in the sink. An item’s own asset and aspect win over the sink’s default.
ih.bulkHelp: Maps the chosen items to one asset and aspect, each with the same variable name as here.
ih.bulkItemsPoints: Those mapped to a data point
ih.namesKeep: The item’s name in the sink as it is
ih.overwrite: Also items that are mapped already
ih.defaultTitle: Default asset and aspect of the sink
ih.defaultHelp: Items without an asset or aspect of their own go here.
ih.assetIdHelp: The asset’s id, or {asset.ref:insights-hub} – the asset’s external reference of that system
ih.csvHelp: Header item,asset_id,asset_name,aspect,variable – one line per item (by its output name or address); “;” works too.
ih.csvMode: Items the file does not list
ih.coversHidden_one: and {{count}} collection you may not see
ih.coversHidden_other: and {{count}} collections you may not see
ih.siteEmpty: No data collection of this site names an Insights Hub platform as a sink. Choose the platform as the target of a sink (collection → Where the data goes).
ih.siteHelp: Per Insights Hub sink of the site’s collections: items mapped to an asset, aspect and variable, verified against the tenant and watched by a monitor.
ih.siteTable: Insights Hub sinks of the site

sinkElement.title: Element from the sink {{name}}
sinkElement.help: The topic this collection writes becomes an MQTT topic element of the data products catalogue, linked to this sink – a pipeline step can then read it. Nothing on the broker is read or changed.
sinkElement.platformHint: Leave empty for a broker that is no platform of Steward, such as the Databus of an edge device.
sinkElement.brokerHint: The Industrial Edge Databus is ie-databus:1883 on its device. It gives the OpenLineage namespace mqtt://host:port.
sinkElement.made: The element {{name}} is in the catalogue
